entries.source: Emerald Canyon Cruise • Swimming • Lunch • Fishing
entries.translation: Emerald Canyon Cruise • Swimming • Lunch • Fishing

entries.source: Discover one of the most scenic and peaceful places in the Mediterranean region, where the Taurus Mountains, emerald water and a relaxing atmosphere create the perfect day away from the city.
entries.translation: Discover one of the most scenic and peaceful places in the Mediterranean region, where the Taurus Mountains, emerald water and a relaxing atmosphere create the perfect day away from the city.

entries.source: Green Canyon is a peaceful and scenic journey to one of the most beautiful natural locations in the Mediterranean region. The majestic Taurus Mountains, emerald water and a deeply relaxing atmosphere create the perfect day away from the city.
entries.translation: Green Canyon is a peaceful and scenic journey to one of the most beautiful natural locations in the Mediterranean region. The majestic Taurus Mountains, emerald water and a deeply relaxing atmosphere create the perfect day away from the city.

entries.source: The experience takes place as a comfortable sightseeing cruise across one of Türkiye’s most beautiful reservoirs. The route is surrounded by dense forests, rocky shores and panoramic natural landscapes.
entries.translation: The experience takes place as a comfortable sightseeing cruise across one of Türkiye’s most beautiful reservoirs. The route is surrounded by dense forests, rocky shores and panoramic natural landscapes.

entries.source: After pickup from your hotel, you travel toward Green Canyon. The journey takes approximately two hours each way. A professional tour guide accompanies the group and shares information about the history, nature and character of the region.
entries.translation: After pickup from your hotel, you travel toward Green Canyon. The journey takes approximately two hours each way. A professional tour guide accompanies the group and shares information about the history, nature and character of the region.

entries.source: On arrival, you board a comfortable sightseeing boat and begin a cruise across the turquoise reservoir among mountain landscapes. The program includes swimming stops, time to relax outdoors, fishing from the boat and panoramic island views.
entries.translation: On arrival, you board a comfortable sightseeing boat and begin a cruise across the turquoise reservoir among mountain landscapes. The program includes swimming stops, time to relax outdoors, fishing from the boat and panoramic island views.

entries.source: Lunch is served at a restaurant by the canyon with a beautiful panoramic view. Main-course choices include chicken, fish or meatballs, accompanied by a side dish and unlimited soft drinks according to the program.
entries.translation: Lunch is served at a restaurant by the canyon with a beautiful panoramic view. Main-course choices include chicken, fish or meatballs, accompanied by a side dish and unlimited soft drinks according to the program.

entries.source: This tour is ideal for families with children, couples and guests who enjoy nature, peaceful surroundings, beautiful photography and a relaxed day outdoors.
entries.translation: This tour is ideal for families with children, couples and guests who enjoy nature, peaceful surroundings, beautiful photography and a relaxed day outdoors.

entries.translation: Swimming stops in clear mountain water

entries.source: Panoramic views of 8 scenic islands from the boat
entries.translation: Panoramic views of 8 scenic islands from the boat

entries.translation: Lakeside lunch with beautiful canyon views

entries.source: A full-day Green Canyon experience combining a cabrio safari, scenic stops, a local zoo visit, lakeside lunch, swimming, fishing and a one-hour boat trip.
entries.translation: A full-day Green Canyon experience combining a cabrio safari, scenic stops, a local zoo visit, lakeside lunch, swimming, fishing and a one-hour boat trip.

entries.source: Pickup from hotels and apartments in Alanya and surrounding resort areas.
entries.translation: Pickup from hotels and apartments in Alanya and surrounding resort areas.

entries.source: Travel toward the Oymapınar and Green Canyon region by cabrio minibus. A professional tour guide accompanies the group and shares information about the area.
entries.translation: Travel toward the Oymapınar and Green Canyon region by cabrio minibus. A professional tour guide accompanies the group and shares information about the area.

entries.source: Begin the first part of the safari around Green Canyon, the dam area and the foothills of the Taurus Mountains.
entries.translation: Begin the first part of the safari around Green Canyon, the dam area and the foothills of the Taurus Mountains.

entries.source: Stop near the ancient Roman aqueducts for sightseeing and memorable photographs.
entries.translation: Stop near the ancient Roman aqueducts for sightseeing and memorable photographs.

entries.source: Enjoy a village-style stop inspired by local nomadic traditions, followed by a fun foam party arranged especially for children.
entries.translation: Enjoy a village-style stop inspired by local nomadic traditions, followed by a fun foam party arranged especially for children.

entries.source: Take a short relaxing break in the gardens along the route before continuing the experience.
entries.translation: Take a short relaxing break in the gardens along the route before continuing the experience.

entries.source: Visit a small local zoo and see a selection of exotic animals. Entrance costs €5 per person. Photos with selected animals may be available for an additional fee, subject to availability and zoo rules.
entries.translation: Visit a small local zoo and see a selection of exotic animals. Entrance costs €5 per person. Photos with selected animals may be available for an additional fee, subject to availability and zoo rules.

entries.source: Stop on a scenic hill for panoramic views over Green Canyon and the Mediterranean coast.
entries.translation: Stop on a scenic hill for panoramic views over Green Canyon and the Mediterranean coast.

entries.source: Enjoy lunch at a restaurant by the lake, followed by free time to relax, swim or try fishing.
entries.translation: Enjoy lunch at a restaurant by the lake, followed by free time to relax, swim or try fishing.

entries.source: Take a peaceful one-hour cruise across the emerald waters of Green Canyon, including swimming breaks according to the program.
entries.translation: Take a peaceful one-hour cruise across the emerald waters of Green Canyon, including swimming breaks according to the program.

entries.source: Continue the second part of the safari through the surrounding mountain and countryside landscape.
entries.translation: Continue the second part of the safari through the surrounding mountain and countryside landscape.

entries.translation: Transfer back to hotels and apartments in Alanya and surrounding areas.

entries.source: Is Green Canyon suitable for children?
entries.translation: Is Green Canyon suitable for children?

entries.source: Yes. The cruise is calm and family-friendly. Parents should supervise children closely during swimming stops and while moving around the boat.
entries.translation: Yes. The cruise is calm and family-friendly. Parents should supervise children closely during swimming stops and while moving around the boat.

entries.source: No. Swimming is optional. Guests may remain on the boat and enjoy the scenery during the stops.
entries.translation: No. Swimming is optional. Guests may remain on the boat and enjoy the scenery during the stops.

entries.source: Fishing equipment is provided on board according to availability and the tour program.
entries.translation: Fishing equipment is provided on board according to availability and the tour program.

entries.source: What food and drinks are included?
entries.translation: What food and drinks are included?

entries.source: Lunch includes a choice of chicken, fish or meatballs with a side dish. Soft drinks are included according to the program.
entries.translation: Lunch includes a choice of chicken, fish or meatballs with a side dish. Soft drinks are included according to the program.

entries.source: The drive takes approximately two hours each way, depending on your pickup area and traffic conditions.
entries.translation: The drive takes approximately two hours each way, depending on your pickup area and traffic conditions.

entries.source: Bring swimwear, a towel, sunscreen, sunglasses, comfortable shoes, weather-appropriate clothing and a phone for contact.
entries.translation: Bring swimwear, a towel, sunscreen, sunglasses, comfortable shoes, weather-appropriate clothing and a phone for contact.

entries.source: Is the local zoo entrance included?
entries.translation: Is the local zoo entrance included?

entries.source: No. Zoo entrance costs €5 per person. Photos with selected animals are available for an additional fee and depend on availability and zoo rules.
entries.translation: No. Zoo entrance costs €5 per person. Photos with selected animals are available for an additional fee and depend on availability and zoo rules.
